content.text: The logs clearly show PaymentProviderFailed errors from api.io-pay.example (503s), and io-pay is a third-party dependency per the service register. No changes/deployments occurred in io-shop around this time. This is a clear upstream dependency failure.

hypotheses.subject: api.io-pay.example
hypotheses.summary: io-shop's account page calls api.io-pay.example (IO Payments Ltd, third-party) to render card info. That dependency began returning 503 errors starting at 15:55:00Z, which cascaded into io-shop's error rate spiking from baseline (~1%) to 100% by 15:56:00Z. No deployment or config change occurred in io-shop in the surrounding window, and CPU/memory show no unusual movement, ruling out internal resource or code causes.
